'''Soul Nexus''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Soul Nexus}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Soul Burn
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (29;{{Asc2|9|31}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Maelstrom
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage ×4.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Drain Life
|Intent = Attack3, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (18;{{Asc2|9|19}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Vulnerable}} and 2 {{BD2|Weak}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable, Weak
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Soul Nexus|Soul Burn}}, then randomly uses {{Int2|Soul Nexus|Soul Burn}}, {{Int2|Soul Nexus|Maelstrom}}, or {{Int2|Soul Nexus|Drain Life}} each turn. No move can be used two turns in a row. All three moves are equally weighted.

== Notes ==

== Trivia ==
* Soul Nexus appears in {{C2|Maul}}'s card art, being bitten by snakes.
